text_block_list.text:
I'm in the camp lodge getting some work
done
while the racers are out on break.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I see you're hard at work, Trainer. Are
those all
adjustments to my regimen?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list:
YЭпизод It's important to make the best out of the
season.

text_block_list.text: Hehe... I appreciate your consideration.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
By the way, are you staying hydrated?
Would you
like a glass of sweetened
barley tea?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I know what you're thinking: sugar, in
barley tea?
Surprising, I know... but it
works well.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Please, have some, and we can relax
for—
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Relax?! Nuh-uh!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Not when you and I have a score to
settle, Grass!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh... El... What has gotten into you all of
a
sudden?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The power of el sol! The crashin' waves
onto la
playa! They call to me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
In other words, your excitement has
bubbled
over, and you want me to help
you burn off the
excess energy?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: That's one way to put it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Grass! A fight! A
competition! I need
some kinda
challenge!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Hmmm... But this is so sudden...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер's smile seems forced, but
this is a
chance to face a rival who will
be racing against
her in the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She might learn something useful. With
that in
mind...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: How about a game of beach flags?
How about a battle of endurance?

text_block_list.text:
So, a race to grab a flag stuck in the
sand?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
A proper activity for some beach-time
fun! Let's
do it! Ándale! Ándale!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Be reasonable, El. You can't just up and
start—
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh? Chickenin' out, Grass?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Well, you always were one of them "take
it slow"
types. Can't blame ya for turnin'
tail when the
goin' gets tough!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Talk all you want. Your cheap little
taunts won't
be getting under my skin.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'll humor you for one round, and one
round only.
So I hope that makes you
happy.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And so, a one-off beach flag match gets

underway.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whoooosh!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whaaa?! Q-qué rápida!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Hehe... Have I ever told you?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I've dabbled in the sword-drawing art of
iaido, so
I have a bit of confidence in my
reaction time. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
So... if I've understood you correctly,
there's a
challenge to eat piping hot
food with the AC off?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Trainer, that's a death wish.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I guess you don't know. Grass might not
look it,
but she hates the heat!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Like right before bed when it's super
humid and
hot, sometimes her tummy—
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: El?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I-is it just me, or did it suddenly
get kinda
chilly?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Thank you for the wonderful

suggestion, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
However, we are Umamusume. We settle
things
with our legs. Therefore...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Why don't we have a race, El? ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It'll help you work off aaaall that excess
energy.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All in all, getting to run alongside El
Condor Pasa
seems to have been a
fruitful experience for
Grass Wonder.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the end, due to Эль Кондор Паса's
constant
requests for a rematch, Grass
Wonder ends up
taking her on several
more times with a confident
smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Later that night, I return to the beach to
find...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Nghh... I went a bit overboard this
afternoon... I'm
gonna be sore tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: You did great, Эль Кондор Паса.

text_block_list.text: Ah, Grass's trainer! Buenas noches.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Gracias for the suggestion earlier! It was
the
release I really needed!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: But I think I ran my tank too dry...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: You and Grass seem like good friends.

text_block_list.text: Haha! Do we?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I tell ya, though. Back when we first
met...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I thought she was a snooze fest 'n a half!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It was durin' the entrance exam for
Tracen
Academy.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
First we all had a once-over to gauge
our
potential. Then it was time to race...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: But me? I was bored outta my mind.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
(Hmmm... I know it's just the entrance
exam, but I
thought Академия Тайсен'd
be more, I dunno,
challengin'?)
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
(Like, more passion, more flair. More
KA-BOOM!
...That's what I'm after.)
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Might you be El Condor
Pasa, by any
chance?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Qué? Ah, yep! That's me.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You and I have been assigned to the
same racing
block. My name is Grass
Wonder.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Even chance meetings are
predetermined. May we
both have a
fruitful race.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I'll see you on the track.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Uh-huh, ditto...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: And that was all! Can ya believe it?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We were right before a race! A big one,
with our
careers on the line!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But she's all lackadaisy 'n smilin'.
Where's the fire?
Where's the drive?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Talk about a letdown. Why do I gotta
run with
this snooze fest, ya know?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: But then...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Fly! Soar! INTO THE SKYYYY!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Wow, look how long her stride is! She
did crazy
good on the other tests too,
but this—this is on a
whole 'nother level!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: She's not the only one.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Weren't you paying attention in the
fitness test?
The one who really put us
all to shame was...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Haaah!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I could tell she was different.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Her form, her aura, her guts! Grass was
nothin'
like the rest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Durin' the race, I'd get the lead, she'd
take it,
then me again, back and forth.
Finally endin' in a
tie.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It was my first taste of it, the burnin'
desire
beneath that mellow grin.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I was shakin' in my cleats.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: That's when I knew!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Heh!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That if I wanna prove myself the world's
strongest
racer, I've gotta beat Grass
Wonder at her best.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take her down head-on when
she's
givin' it her all!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And then everyone'll see that no one's
faster than
the one, the only... El Condor
Pasa!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I can see the determination burning in El
Condor
Pasa's eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It's gotta be me.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I swear I'll have those gentle blue eyes boiling as she watches me tear down the turf!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Oops! I said a little too much there!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'll fill ya in later, after the startin' gate
opens!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Adiós... 'Til the Japan Cup!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And with that, Эль Кондор Паса runs like
the wind
into the night.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
